motion.beats: 0.00 the push-in and letterbox (the shipped Overdrive rig) · 0.30 the band slashes in (the gold strokes run ahead of the fill) · 0.50 the word stamps · hold with a slow drift · 1.98 slides out along its own axis · 2.30 back to the battle
0.00 the real hit (engine frames) · 0.25 the band slashes in · 0.45 the chain numeral stamps · hold · 1.98 slides out · 2.30 the engine frames resume
